Sophisticated vintage jazz-club graphic design, strictly warm ivory cream and deep burgundy duotone, subtle paper grain, generous negative space, elegant bold condensed vintage serif display lettering and clean readable small typography. Flat screenprinted illustration of a burgundy saxophone, rooftop balustrade and a few city skyline silhouettes, small stars, subtle art-deco border. NOT a photograph or mockup. A coherent premium editorial layout. Keep all lettering well inside the frame with ample top and bottom story-safe margins. Exact visible text, spelled perfectly, no other words: large title 'ROOFTOP JAZZ'; below title '17 October 2027'; next line '7 PM'; lower information block 'Atlas Roof'; and 'Free entry'. Title and event information high contrast, crisp and large enough to read on a phone. Put illustration in middle and keep text in uncluttered cream areas. Cream background, burgundy ink throughout.
